queries.sql: SELECT `p`.`id`, `p`.`nomor_urut`, `p`.`nama_peserta`, `p`.`alamat`, `p`.`no_wa`, `p`.`jenis_kelamin`, `p`.`foto`, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN u.role = 'juri_tetap' THEN pn.nilai END), 0) as avg_juri_tetap, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN u.role = 'juri_tamu' THEN pn.nilai END), 0) as avg_juri_tamu, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN u.role = 'sosmed' THEN pn.nilai END), 0) as nilai_sosmed, ( (COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN u.role = 'juri_tetap' THEN pn.nilai END), 0) * 0.60) + (COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN u.role = 'juri_tamu' THEN pn.nilai END), 0) * 0.30) + (COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN u.role = 'sosmed' THEN pn.nilai END), 0) * 0.10) ) as nilai_akhir FROM `peserta` `p` LEFT JOIN `penilaian` `pn` ON `pn`.`peserta_id` = `p`.`id` AND `pn`.`tgl_vote` = '2026-09-12' LEFT JOIN `users` `u` ON `u`.`id` = `pn`.`juri_id` GROUP BY `p`.`id` ORDER BY `nilai_akhir` DESC
